body:
## The Final Chapter of My Collegiate ICPC Journey

On **30 October 2026**, I stepped into the computer laboratory of **Southeast University** to compete in my **final collegiate ICPC Preliminary contest**. From taking my first tentative steps in competitive programming back in 2024 to sitting at this workstation today, this contest represented not just another contest on the scoreboard, but the emotional and professional culmination of years of relentless practice, late-night debugging, and deep algorithmic exploration.

Competing under the team name **SEU_Dynamites**, I had the honor of sharing the contest desk with my dedicated teammates **Rakib** and **Abid**. Together, we spent the five hours communicating intensely, breaking down intricate problem statements, formulating proofs on scratch paper, and verifying edge cases before submitting our solutions on the BAPSOJ platform.

## Inspiring Guidance from Respected Faculty Mentors

What made this event truly extraordinary was the inspiring presence, continuous encouragement, and close supervision of our respected teachers and departmental leaders who stood by us in the lab throughout the contest:

- **Shahriar Manzoor** — Chairman & Associate Professor
- **Dr. Md. Ruhul Amin** — Associate Professor
- **Shifat Ahmed** — Assistant Professor
- **Tashreef Muhammad** — Co-ordinator & Lecturer
- **Sakib Mahmud** — Lecturer
- **Rifat Ahommed** — Lecturer
- **Md. Shamim** — Lecturer

Having distinguished academic mentors—especially world-renowned competitive programming pioneer Shahriar Manzoor Sir and our faculty members—standing right beside us in the arena gave all participating teams an immense boost in morale and confidence.

We also express our heartfelt appreciation to the dedicated **student volunteers** whose meticulous support with system preparations, problem distribution, lab management, and refreshments ensured a flawless and professional contest environment.

## Cherishing Every Moment with Team SEU_Dynamites

Throughout the contest, our team synergy was at its absolute best. When one of us tackled the mathematical nuances of a problem on paper, another crafted clean, optimized code on the terminal, while the third maintained vigilance over boundary constraints and potential runtime pitfalls. The camaraderie, shared laughter, and high-fives over successful verdicts made this final contest an unforgettable memory of my university life.

These photographs capture team **SEU_Dynamites** at work, our honorable faculty members overseeing the contest hall, the initial problem distribution, and a memorable post-contest moment with my teammates.

## Key Takeaways

- **The Emotional & Professional Climax of Collegiate CP:** Experiencing my final ICPC reinforced that competitive programming is not just about rankings—it is an enduring foundation of grit, mental stamina, and mathematical discipline that will continue to guide my software engineering career.
- **Synergistic Team Chemistry Under Fire:** Competing as SEU_Dynamites with Rakib and Abid proved that transparent communication, rapid task delegation, and mutual trust under relentless countdown timers are the decisive factors in tackling complex contest problem sets.
- **The Power of Academic Mentorship & Community:** Having our esteemed professors, department chairman, and student volunteers standing together in the arena highlighted the rich, empowering problem-solving ecosystem fostered within Southeast University.
